application.name: Portfolio Admin Dashboard
application.description: Admin dashboard for the public portfolio at profile.eduardoinerarte.dk. It manages the portfolio content (experiences, skills, projects, testimonials, services, content blocks and their translations), the registered users, and the site + AI settings.

main.label: Dashboard
main.description: Landing page of the dashboard. Five live counters (users, experiences, projects, skills, testimonials) and quick links into each portfolio section.
main.descriptionEs: Página de inicio del dashboard. Cinco contadores en vivo (usuarios, experiencias, proyectos, habilidades, testimonios) y accesos directos a cada sección del portafolio.

main.label: Users
main.description: Registered users of the application, in a sortable and filterable table.
main.descriptionEs: Usuarios registrados de la aplicación, en una tabla ordenable y filtrable.

main.label: Portfolio
main.description: Overview of every portfolio section, with a shortcut into each editor.
main.descriptionEs: Vista general de todas las secciones del portafolio, con acceso a cada editor.

main.label: Experiences
main.description: Work history shown on the public site. Each entry has a company, role, period and per-language translations.
main.descriptionEs: Historial laboral que aparece en el sitio público. Cada entrada tiene empresa, cargo, periodo y traducciones por idioma.

main.label: Skills & Tech
main.description: Technologies listed on the public site, with category and proficiency.
main.descriptionEs: Tecnologías que se listan en el sitio público, con categoría y nivel.

main.label: Projects
main.description: Portfolio projects: cover image, links, stack and per-language descriptions.
main.descriptionEs: Proyectos del portafolio: imagen de portada, enlaces, stack y descripciones por idioma.

main.label: Testimonials
main.description: Client and colleague quotes, with author, role and per-language text.
main.descriptionEs: Citas de clientes y colegas, con autor, cargo y texto por idioma.

main.label: Services
main.description: Services offered on the public site, with title and description per language.
main.descriptionEs: Servicios ofrecidos en el sitio público, con título y descripción por idioma.

main.label: Content Blocks
main.description: Free-form copy blocks the public site renders (hero, about, section intros).
main.descriptionEs: Bloques de texto libre que el sitio público renderiza (hero, sobre mí, introducciones).

main.label: Translations
main.description: Side-by-side editor for the English, Spanish and Danish strings of every portfolio record.
main.descriptionEs: Editor lado a lado de los textos en inglés, español y danés de cada registro del portafolio.

main.label: Settings
main.description: Settings home: language, theme, and links to the system, AI and site panels.
main.descriptionEs: Inicio de configuración: idioma, tema y enlaces a los paneles de sistema, IA y sitio.

main.label: System Settings
main.description: Runtime and environment settings for the application itself.
main.descriptionEs: Ajustes de entorno y ejecución de la propia aplicación.

main.label: AI Configuration
main.description: Choose the AI provider and model, set base URLs, keys and generation parameters.
main.descriptionEs: Elegir proveedor y modelo de IA, definir URLs base, claves y parámetros de generación.

main.label: Site Settings
main.description: Public-site metadata: title, description and social preview used for SEO.
main.descriptionEs: Metadatos del sitio público: título, descripción y vista previa social para SEO.

main.label: AI Help
main.description: Chat with the assistant about this dashboard and its data.
main.descriptionEs: Chatear con el asistente sobre este dashboard y sus datos.

secondary.label: Settings
secondary.description: Language, theme, and the system, AI and site panels.
secondary.descriptionEs: Idioma, tema y los paneles de sistema, IA y sitio.

secondary.label: Get Help
secondary.description: AI chat assistant with markdown rendering and code highlighting.
secondary.descriptionEs: Asistente de IA con renderizado markdown y resaltado de código.

secondary.label: Search
secondary.action: Cmd+K / Ctrl+K opens the search sheet

dataOverview.note: Counts are not stored here. They are read from the database per request and appended to the context as [Live Counts].

whereToFind.users: Go to /dashboard/users to browse registered users.
whereToFind.portfolio: Go to /dashboard/portfolio for an overview of every portfolio section.
whereToFind.experiences: Go to /dashboard/portfolio/experiences to manage work history.
whereToFind.projects: Go to /dashboard/portfolio/projects to manage portfolio projects.
whereToFind.content: Go to /dashboard/portfolio/content to edit the public site copy blocks.
whereToFind.translations: Go to /dashboard/portfolio/translations to edit English, Spanish and Danish side by side.
whereToFind.settings: Go to /dashboard/settings for language and theme, /dashboard/settings/ia_config for the AI provider, and /dashboard/settings/site for public-site metadata.
whereToFind.help: Go to /dashboard/help to chat with the assistant.
whereToFind.dashboard: Go to /dashboard for live counts of users, experiences, projects, skills and testimonials.

howTo.addProject: Go to /dashboard/portfolio/projects and create a record, then add its English, Spanish and Danish text in /dashboard/portfolio/translations.
howTo.translateContent: Every portfolio record carries a translation per language. Edit them together in /dashboard/portfolio/translations.
howTo.changeLanguage: The interface language is in /dashboard/settings. It is separate from the languages the public site is published in.
howTo.changeAiProvider: Go to /dashboard/settings/ia_config, pick the provider and model, and save.
howTo.exportUsers: Open /dashboard/users and use Export to download the current rows as CSV.

aiCapabilities.description: The assistant answers questions about this dashboard. It is given the page map above plus live counts read from the database at request time.
canDo: Point to the page that holds a given kind of data
Report how many users, experiences, projects, skills, testimonials, services or content blocks exist right now
Explain what each page does and what it edits
cannotDo: Create, edit or delete records. There is no write path from the chat; every change is made in its own page.
